business_problem: Bosch Digital needed to store and analyze high-volume IoT data in real time across varied use cases without rigid schemas or slow analytical workflows.
solution_summary: Bosch Digital uses MongoDB Atlas and Time Series Collections inside Bosch IoT Insights to collect, manage, and analyze industrial data from connected tools, vehicles, and other assets in real time. The platform handles structured, semi-structured, and unstructured IoT data, mapping each device to a document model that is easier to evolve than traditional relational or object-storage-based approaches. That lets Bosch expose alerts, maintenance schedules, audit trails, and other insight services across industries such as aerospace, automotive, retail, energy, and agriculture while still supporting fast indexing, geospatial and text search, and complex aggregation. The result is quicker innovation for Bosch and faster, data-driven decisions for its customers.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores IoT telemetry and operational data for Bosch IoT Insights.

solution_components.name: Time Series Collections
solution_components.role: Optimizes storage for high-volume timestamped data from connected devices.

data_flow: IoT telemetry from tools, devices, and sensors lands in MongoDB Atlas and Time Series Collections, where Bosch analyzes it in real time, triggers alerts, and exposes maintenance and audit data to operators and regulators.
business_outcome: Bosch Digital helps customers analyze IoT data immediately, innovate faster, and support new AI- and ML-driven use cases without reworking schemas.
metrics: Bosch IoT Insights captures data from power tools used to tighten the six million screws, nuts, and bolts on an airplane.
